title: KeyRegistry
description: A Glyph server's published list of signing keys, their validity windows, and the chain-of-trust links between rotations.

registryVersion.description: Wire version of the registry format.

serverId.description: An opaque identifier the server chose for itself (e.g. a domain).

active.description: Fingerprint (hex) of the currently active key — the one that signs the outer signature and any new cards/receipts.

issuedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this registry was published.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature, produced by the active key, over the canonical hash of every other field.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of publicKey (hex). Stable identifier across rotations.

validFrom.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this key became active.

validUntil.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this key was rotated out. Absent on the active key.

revokedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this key was explicitly revoked.

signedBy.description: Fingerprint of the key that authorised this entry. Absent on the genesis entry.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature over canonical hash of (fingerprint, publicKey, validFrom, signedBy). Absent on the genesis entry.
